notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The refrigerator stays open while later cabinet and drawer interactions occur; intervening camera repositioning around it is not counted as additional refrigerator episodes. The two leaves of the upper cabinet are reported separately because they are distinct movable parts and appear to be opened and closed in close succession.
scene_description: A user moves through a compact kitchen and manipulates the refrigerator door, both leaves of the cabinet above the range hood, and the top drawer beside the oven.
